spans.s:
खण्ड a. broken, crippled, defective, not full (moon). m.
n. break, fragment, piece, part, section (of a book), sickle (of the
moon);
 number, multitude.
खण्डधारा f. a kind of dance or air.

खण्डन a. breaking to pieces, destroying, removing, n.
the act of breaking etc., also wounding, injuring, interrupting,
frustrating, refusing, cheating, deceiving.

खण्डय् खण्ड˚यति pp. खण्डित break or cut to
pieces, divide, dispel, hurt, wound, destroy;
 interrupt, violate,
transgress, frustrate, disappoint, refute, cheat, deceive. — वि cut
to pieces, tear asunder, interrupt, trouble.

खण्डशस् adv. in or to pieces. — With कृ, कल्पय् &
परिकल्पय् cut asunder, divide.
खण्डितवृत्त a. immoral (lit. of broken conduct).
